submitted.rationale: AgSbO3 (Ag:Sb 1:1, visible-light-absorbing antimonate) is the only known ternary phase near the middle of the line, so measurements targeted that region. EQE was 0.405% at index 11 (Ag 0.43), 0.867% at index 9 (Ag 0.51) and 0.893% at index 8 (Ag 0.55). Index 8 had the highest measured merit.
